prompt: Yumi will make a small home for the street cat if the owner (to agree).
explanation_ru: Это реальное условие о будущем: после if глагол стоит в настоящем времени, а не в will.

prompt: Will we eat in the garden if the lights (to work)?
explanation_ru: В вопросе о реальном будущем после if идёт настоящее время: the lights work.

prompt: Can Olivia try the scarf on if the seller (to let) her?
explanation_ru: После if в условии о будущем используется Present Simple: lets.

prompt: I'll start the channel if the microphone (to arrive).
explanation_ru: После if в реальном условии о будущем глагол стоит в Present Simple, без will.

prompt: I won't run the race if my knee (to hurt).
explanation_ru: Условие о возможном будущем: после if нужен Present Simple — hurts.

prompt: I will email the team when I (to finish) my work.
explanation_ru: После when о будущем тоже ставим настоящее время: when I finish.

prompt: Ewa will run the free story hour if the library (to provide) the room and chairs.
explanation_ru: Реальное условие: после if глагол в Present Simple — provides.

prompt: Greta will not buy the tickets if her sister (not / to come) with her.
explanation_ru: Отрицание в if-части строится в Present Simple: does not come.

prompt: Anh will join the study group if the library (to stay) open late.
explanation_ru: После if в условии о будущем — Present Simple: stays.

prompt: I'll accept the job if the company (to pay) my moving costs.
explanation_ru: В if-части реального условия о будущем нужен Present Simple — pays.

prompt: Stoyan (to extend) his stay if a room with a lake view (to open) up, but he (not / to stay) if none (to appear).
explanation_ru: В главной части — will (будущее решение), а после if — Present Simple: opens, appears.

prompt: Sigrid has an interview call after lunch and needs a quiet room. If her boss (not / to agree), she (to take) the call in the corridor. She hopes the office will be free.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное условие — does not agree, результат — will take.

prompt: Noor sees a beginner stuck halfway up the climbing wall. If he (to want) help, she (to show) him an easier way down. She waits below.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (wants), в главной части — will show.

prompt: Natalia's son will join the class if the instructor ___ him a place.
explanation_ru: После if в реальном условии о будущем нельзя ставить will: нужно gives.

prompt: If they find my umbrella, I ___ it back.
explanation_ru: Это конкретное будущее событие, поэтому в главной части — will get, а не get.

prompt: If you lose your costume list, ___ the wardrobe team for a new one.
explanation_ru: Здесь результат — совет-повелительное наклонение: call, без will.

prompt: James asks: '___ I use the big oven if the centre has a free slot?'
explanation_ru: Для вежливой просьбы о разрешении нужен модальный Can, а не Will.

prompt: Weronika will tell the group when she ___ how many volunteers are coming.
explanation_ru: После when о будущем ставим настоящее время: when she knows.

prompt: If Sara will have time, she will help paint the stage.
answer: If Sara has time, she will help paint the stage.
accepted_answers: If Sara has time, she will help paint the stage.
If Sara has time, she'll help paint the stage.

prompt: Kaia will hold the book club there if the owner will let her book the side room.
answer: Kaia will hold the book club there if the owner lets her book the side room.
accepted_answers: Kaia will hold the book club there if the owner lets her book the side room.

prompt: Lars will show the student how to focus the telescope if she needs help.
answer: Lars will show the student how to focus the telescope if she needs help.
accepted_answers: Lars will show the student how to focus the telescope if she needs help.
explanation_ru: Предложение верное: после if — Present Simple (needs), в главной части — will show.

prompt: I see an old man struggling with a heavy suitcase at the station stairs. Which offer fits best?
options: If you need help, I will carry the suitcase for you.
If you needed help, I would carry the suitcase for you.
If you will need help, I carry the suitcase for you.
If you need help, I carried the suitcase for you.
explanation_ru: Реальное предложение помощи о будущем — первый тип: if you need, I will carry.

prompt: Amara is checking out of her hotel and wants to leave her bags in the lobby. Which question fits?
options: Will I be allowed to leave my bags here if I ask the desk?
Would I be allowed to leave my bags here if I asked the desk?
Will I be allowed to leave my bags here if I will ask the desk?
Am I allowed to leave my bags here if I asked the desk?
explanation_ru: Реальная просьба о будущем: if I ask (Present Simple) и модальный will be allowed.

prompt: Match each beginning with its correct ending.
pairs: Hyejin will keep bees in the far corner.
she will read it at once.
explanation_ru: Каждое условие соединяется с результатом в will: if/when + Present Simple → will.

prompt: Put each sentence into the right group.

items.text: If you drop a glass, it breaks.
Water freezes if it gets very cold.
If Emi adds too much sugar, the juice is too sweet.
If Emi opens the shop, she will sell fresh juice.
If the weather is good, Emi will put tables outside.
If the market says yes, Emi will start selling.

explanation_ru: Общая истина (нулевой тип) — Present + Present; конкретное будущее (первый тип) — Present + will.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: The runner will race if the physio says her ankle is fine.
accepted_answers: The runner will race if the physio says her ankle is fine.
The physio says the runner will race if her ankle is fine.
explanation_ru: Порядок: главная часть с will, затем if + Present Simple.
